failure.name: AssertionError
failure.cause: The closure checker initially assumed finalLedgerManifest.artifacts.finalLedger was a hash-bearing object. The frozen checkpoint and batch manifests use a path string there; the immutable ledger hash is independently locked by the calculated-score artifact and the manifest source hash chain.

diagnosedCorrection.minimumChange: Accept the historical string path shape while continuing to verify the ledger SHA-256 against calculatedScores.sources.finalLedgerSha256 and every frozen final-ledger source reference.
